headline: Human Resources Professional
summary: Detail-oriented HR professional with a focus on talent acquisition, employee engagement, and organizational development. Passionate about building inclusive workplace cultures within the dynamic corporate landscape of Nepal.

experiences.title: Human Resources Executive
description: Manage end-to-end recruitment process for entry-level and mid-level positions across multiple manufacturing units.
Coordinate onboarding programs to reduce new-hire attrition by 15% annually.
Maintain HRIS databases and ensure compliance with the Labor Act of Nepal.
Facilitate performance appraisal cycles for over 200 employees.

experiences.title: HR Intern
description: Assisted in shortlisting candidates and scheduling interviews for the sales department.
Supported the HR team in organizing employee welfare activities and annual staff events.
Maintained physical and digital personnel files ensuring data integrity.
